findings.title: Foreign-tenant portfolio/override isolation
findings.product_decision: Code-derived parent-tenant invariant; independently validate with request/DB tests

tests.assertion: Tenant B JWT receives 404/403 for tenant A portfolio read/export; zero foreign data returned; owner A access succeeds
Tenant B override request denied; original portfolio skill, override and downstream report unchanged
Foreign vacancy/portfolio combinations denied in request and worker; no report persisted, same-tenant succeeds

findings.title: Candidate completion must not finalize pending/uncovered session
findings.product_decision: Completion semantics require server-issued readiness proof; exact mechanism proposed, not approved

tests.assertion: Pending invite audio_complete denied; status remains pending; no portfolio job
Active uncovered interview cannot be declared all_covered by candidate-only call; no final row/job
Server-confirmed completed session ends exactly once and queues a single portfolio job
Repeated/concurrent completion does not duplicate state transitions, jobs or portfolio rows

findings.title: Fit/gap reports stale after vacancy edit
findings.product_decision: Decide invalidate/recompute vs explicit historical snapshot; current unversioned cache implies freshness

tests.assertion: After vacancy required level edit, stale report not returned as current
Recomputed report and API JSON/PDF export expected_level match DB vacancy skills
Concurrent edit/queued jobs do not expose wrong-version report or preserve stale cache

findings.title: Invalid generated scores silently clamped
findings.product_decision: Decide reject/retry/unassessed policy; silently authoritative L1/L5 is disallowed

tests.assertion: Valid integer 1..5 stored precisely, evidence and portfolio association preserved
nil, n/a, noninteger and out-of-range never persisted as plausible L1/L5
Invalid generated data does not leave complete portfolio with partial/false saved skills; explicit failed/retry state

findings.title: Duplicate vacancy skill labels collapse in comparison
findings.product_decision: PENDING product choice: reject duplicates or retain distinct skills by stable identity

tests.assertion: Two stored rows with same label never silently collapse into one: either both compared or write rejected explicitly
Blank/case-variant/custom labels follow explicitly chosen uniqueness rule; compare count/IDs/levels to DB

findings.title: Coverage WebSocket lacks assessor role check
findings.product_decision: Assessor-only inferred from protected REST/monitoring purpose, confirm policy

tests.assertion: Signed non-assessor JWT denied before coverage payload is emitted
Assessor JWT from tenant B denied tenant A coverage frames
Assessor from owner tenant receives permitted current coverage state
Expired/invalid JWT denied and no coverage bytes leaked

findings.title: Caller-selected tenant on login
findings.product_decision: PENDING global-admin vs tenant-admin privilege model and tenant-membership source

tests.assertion: Tenant-bound admin must not mint another tenant JWT from arbitrary scheme header; behavior conditional on decided policy
Authorized home-tenant login succeeds and JWT claims match resolved permitted tenant
If global admin is designed, privileged tenant switch requires explicit grant with corresponding positive/negative tests

findings.title: Candidate invite origin configured as backend
findings.product_decision: Frontend owns interview route; define WEB_BASE_URL or equivalent explicit public origin

tests.assertion: Generated invite URL has configured frontend origin/route, not API host
Path uses encoded invite token and no malformed slash/unsafe route concatenation
DEV/staging/prod public origin injection and rendered copied link consistent with backend value

findings.title: Invite token lifecycle policy undefined
findings.product_decision: PENDING defined TTL, revocation, use after end, replay and WS validation

tests.assertion: When policy specified, HTTP/WS reject expired/revoked token and define valid-before behavior without inventing TTL

findings.title: No tracked critical regressions or CI gate
findings.product_decision: Case-study mandatory engineering input; release blocker even though P2 user-facing severity

tests.assertion: Behavior-changing code without linked executable tests is blocked
Presence of vacuous test cannot be accepted as meaningful; machine ensures execution, human reviews semantics
Workflow/validator change triggers regression policy tests and explicit human review
Required test or job skipped/failed/zero discovered cases cannot yield green status
Tag with failing/missing check is BLOCKED
Tag with unresolved unaccepted P0/P1 is BLOCKED independent of green builds
Actual tested version SHA with passing gates and cleared/accepted risk is eligible; remote proof required

findings.title: No linked PRD/AC/design plan
findings.product_decision: Case-study mandatory engineering input; wiki external not audited

tests.assertion: Missing/invalid spec link causes nonzero exit
Missing/invalid acceptance criteria causes nonzero exit
Missing/invalid solution design causes nonzero exit
Well-linked coherent docs+test mapping pass metadata gate only; not proof overall CI green
External, traversed or placeholder doc path fails even if text includes checkbox
Strict docs-only exemption does not exempt malformed docs or hidden code changes

findings.title: Local development setup document conflicts
findings.product_decision: Choose monorepo-relative commands and one canonical API/web port contract

tests.assertion: README startup paths, ports and env variable names agree with actual config and service startup

findings.title: Signup artifact not accessible
findings.product_decision: PENDING product decision whether self-signup is in/out of scope

tests.assertion: If in scope, route+API success/error/auth tests; otherwise document intentional absence and remove orphan consumer
